summary: Stabilised oxychloro complex is a chlorite-based preservative in lubricant and glaucoma eye drops. It breaks down to water, sodium and chloride on exposure to light and tear film, so it is gentler on the cornea than benzalkonium chloride.
indications: Used as a preservative in eye drops in combination products; it has no therapeutic indication of its own

dosage.d: No therapeutic dose; present as a preservative in eye drops
dosage.n: The dose is that of the product's active ingredients

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Oxidative antimicrobial; degrades on contact with the eye.
preg: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
lact: No specific concern at excipient concentrations
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
refs: Martindale: The Complete Drug Reference (Pharmaceutical Press)
